shots: I died an atheist during heart surgery and woke up outside Heaven's gate.
I accidentally bumped into the angel playing the harp. CRASH! The music stopped.
Three strings hung loose. I lifted the harp by its column, and a piece snapped off in my hand. CRACK! The base split.
Every angel and new arrival turned toward me. The harpist stared at what was left of her instrument.
That was the ONLY harp at Heaven's gate. I wanted to disappear. How was I supposed to make this right?
I had spent my life insisting this place didn't exist. Now they probably wished I didn't exist.
Can't someone here fix it? The harpist pointed to spare strings. That's not how things work here. Only the person who broke it can repair it. I can guide you, but I can't touch it.
A family reached the gate. Their daughter looked at the silent harp. Why isn't anyone playing? The answer traveled fast. The new arrival broke it.
Everyone watched as I threaded a string where the harpist pointed. PING! It whipped my nose. My gown caught a pedal, and I landed on my face.
Careful with the column. After a few tries, I secured ONE string. Two remained. Then the gates began to FADE.
The harpist looked up. Your heart started again. I stared at the broken harp. But I'm not finished.
Then Heaven stays quiet until you return. One by one, the angels shook their heads.
SORRY! I woke in recovery. My surgeon smiled. The operation was successful.
I reached for my phone. Calling your family? I'm finding someone who can teach me harp repair.
I had a second chance at life and a broken harp waiting for me at the end of it.
